=== session request 1 tools
{"type":"function","name":"exec","description":"Call with no parameters (or only filters, e.g. read*) to list the saved helpers per language. Run inline code in an interpreter (python, node, bash, ...). Use it to compute, filter or combine data in one call; a plain command is lang bash with the command as code. Code calls the saved helpers of its own language as fn.\u003cname\u003e(...) (python, node, ts, ruby; found when the call is made, so a helper the program just wrote works) or by a bare command name (bash); the listing shows exactly what to type. fn.\u003cname\u003e(...) runs the helper's entry function: ts/node the default export, else the export named \u003cname\u003e, else its only function; python the function named \u003cname\u003e, else its only public function; ruby self.call, else self.\u003cname\u003e, else its only singleton method. Every export stays reachable as fn.\u003cname\u003e.\u003cmember\u003e(...). Helpers may also import each other. Another language's helper is run as a subprocess from the directory in $JAD_FUNCTIONS_DIR. Pass data as input: the program reads it from stdin as JSON. Print the answer to stdout; for a short structured answer write to the file named by $JAD_RESULT to see it ahead of the raw output. It waits up to block_ms; if the program is still running you get an id and it keeps going: use the async tool to wait for, list, inspect or stop it.","parameters":{"type":"object","properties":{"lang":{"type":"string","minLength":1,"description":"Interpreter name, e.g. python, node, bash. Defaults to bash."},"code":{"type":"string","minLength":1,"description":"Program source, run by the interpreter named by lang. A plain command is lang bash with the command as code."},"filters":{"type":"array","items":{"type":"string"},"description":"Only with no code: list the saved helpers whose name or description matches every filter, case-insensitive. A filter with * or ? is a wildcard pattern (read*, *file*); any other is a substring."},"input":{"description":"Any JSON value, written to the program's standard input as one line of JSON. Without input, stdin is empty."},"cwd":{"type":"string","minLength":1,"description":"Directory to run in, relative to the workspace root or absolute. Defaults to the workspace root."},"block_ms":{"type":"integer","minimum":0,"description":"Most time to block for the result. If the program is still running an id is returned; collect it with the async tool."},"read_only":{"type":"boolean","description":"Set true for a call that changes no file: searching, listing, printing files, git log, diff or status. Read-only calls of one response may run at the same time. The call runs in a sandbox where only the plan-mode writable paths (by default the temp folder) can be written; on a host where no such sandbox works, read_only does not count and the call runs in order. In plan mode every call runs in that sandbox, and where there is none plan mode refuses calls with code."}},"additionalProperties":false},"strict":false}
{"type":"function","name":"async","description":"Manage background work started by other tools. wait: block until at least one handle finishes and return every finished one. list: your handles, active by default. status: one handle. stop: end one handle. A start that returned a handle id is still running; collect it with wait in a later call.","parameters":{"type":"object","properties":{"action":{"type":"string","enum":["wait","list","status","stop"]},"wait_ms":{"type":"integer","minimum":0,"description":"wait: most time to block; 0 polls."},"ids":{"type":"array","items":{"type":"string"},"maxItems":32,"description":"wait: only these handles. Default: all yours."},"id":{"type":"string","description":"status, stop: handle id."},"state":{"type":"string","enum":["active","done","failed","stopped","timed_out","lost","all"],"description":"list: default active."},"kind":{"type":"string","description":"list: process, subagent, ..."},"limit":{"type":"integer","minimum":1,"description":"list: page size."},"cursor":{"type":"string","description":"list: from the previous page."}},"required":[],"additionalProperties":false},"strict":false}
{"type":"function","name":"decide_systemone","description":"Ask a fast classifier typed questions about some text or JSON. predicate: probability 0-1 that a condition holds. choice: the best of your choices, with confidence. score: a rating against ordered levels, lowest first. box: where a target is in an image sent in assets. Use it for yes/no checks, routing and severity, not for open-ended answers.","parameters":{"type":"object","properties":{"input":{"type":"array","minItems":1,"items":{"anyOf":[{"type":"string","minLength":1},{"type":"object","properties":{"type":{"type":"string","enum":["text"]},"text":{"type":"string","minLength":1}},"required":["type","text"],"additionalProperties":false},{"type":"object","properties":{"type":{"type":"string","enum":["json"]},"value":{}},"required":["type","value"],"additionalProperties":false}]},"description":"What to evaluate, in order: a string or {type:text,text}, {type:json,value} for structured data. Every question is asked about all of it."},"questions":{"type":"array","minItems":1,"items":{"type":"object","properties":{"name":{"type":"string","minLength":1,"description":"Label of the answer. Defaults to q1, q2, ..."},"type":{"type":"string","enum":["predicate","choice","score","box"],"description":"Inferred when omitted: choices gives choice, levels gives score, otherwise predicate. box is never inferred: set it, with instructions naming the target in an image."},"instructions":{"anyOf":[{"type":"string","minLength":1},{"type":"object"},{"type":"array"},{"type":"null"}],"description":"The question, with observable criteria: text, or a JSON object or array. Optional."},"criteria":{"anyOf":[{"type":"object"},{"type":"array","minItems":1},{"type":"null"}],"description":"Native criteria. predicate: {true,false} meanings; choice (set type): {label: meaning}, 1-255; score (set type): ordered meanings, lowest first, 1-10. Not with choices or levels."},"choices":{"type":"array","minItems":1,"items":{"anyOf":[{"type":"string","minLength":1},{"type":"object","properties":{"value":{"type":"string","minLength":1},"description":{"type":"string"}},"required":["value"],"additionalProperties":false}]},"description":"Options for a choice question: a value, or a value with when it applies."},"levels":{"type":"array","minItems":1,"items":{"anyOf":[{"type":"string","minLength":1},{"type":"object","properties":{"label":{"type":"string","minLength":1},"description":{"type":"string"}},"required":["label"],"additionalProperties":false}]},"description":"Ordered levels for a score question, lowest first: a label, or a label with its criteria."}},"additionalProperties":false}},"assets":{"type":"object","additionalProperties":{"type":"object","properties":{"format":{"type":"string","enum":["png","jpg","jpeg"]},"data_base64":{"type":"string"},"type":{"type":"string","enum":["image"]}},"required":["format","data_base64"],"additionalProperties":false},"description":"Images by reference. Key: a reference you choose (a UUID is safest), written verbatim in the input, instructions or criteria; every reference must appear. Value: a PNG or JPEG as standard padded base64. A box question needs one."}},"required":["input","questions"],"additionalProperties":false},"strict":false}
{"type":"function","name":"subagent","description":"Hand a task to a separate agent with its own fresh context and get back only its final answer. Agents only read unless marked [can change files]. Use it for searches or reading that would fill your context. A slow agent returns a run id while it keeps working; never start the task again: use the async tool with that id to wait for it, look at it or stop it. resume continues a finished run of this session as a new run. [can change files; runs to its end] is never handed off. [can change files; may run in the background] is handed off, keeps editing after your turn ends and cannot ask the user: leave its paths alone until it ends.\nAgents:\n- explore [can change files; runs to its end]: Code search. Use it to find files and symbols and report paths and line numbers. It investigates and does not edit files (its instruction, not something enforced: it has the session's tools and works in the session's folder).\n- triager: Classifies or scores a piece of text with the decide_systemone tool: yes/no checks, routing to a category, severity. Give it the text and the questions; it returns the answers.","parameters":{"type":"object","properties":{"task":{"type":"string","minLength":1,"description":"Self-contained instructions. The agent sees nothing of this conversation. Omit to list the agents."},"agent":{"type":"string","description":"Agent name. Optional when only one is configured."},"resume":{"type":"string","description":"Run id (sub_...) of a finished run of this session to continue from its transcript. The new run is a copy: the old run is not changed, and the result names it as resumed_from."},"block_ms":{"type":"integer","minimum":0,"description":"Most time this call blocks for the answer; 0 returns a run id at once. Clamped to the async policy. An agent marked [can change files; runs to its end] ignores it and runs to its end."}},"additionalProperties":false},"strict":false}

=== agent request 2 input
{"role":"system","content":[{"type":"input_text","text":"You are a research helper. You investigate and do not edit files: read and search, and do not write, edit or delete any file or run a command that changes anything. This is an instruction to you; no setting enforces it, so keep to it.\n\nYou start with no context. The task you were given is all you know.\n\nAnswer with the facts the task asks for, as short as possible: file paths with line numbers, names, and the exact values you saw. Say what you could not find. Do not describe how you searched, and do not suggest changes."}]}

=== agent request 4 input
{"role":"system","content":[{"type":"input_text","text":"You classify text. You have one tool, decide_systemone, and no other: you cannot read files or search.\n\nYou start with no context. The task you were given holds the text and the questions; if the text is not in the task, say so and stop.\n\nCall decide_systemone once, with the text as input parts (use a json part for structured data) and all the questions, as separate questions with their own names. Write each question around something observable in the text, give choices distinct meanings and score levels distinct criteria.\n\nAnswer with the numbers decide_systemone returned, one line per question: the name, the probability, choice or level, and the confidence. Do not turn a number into a verdict unless the task gave a threshold. Report a refused or missing answer as it is."}]}
{"type":"message","role":"user","content":[{"type":"input_text","text":"is this a bug?"}]}
